summary: Successfully tested day scenario selector feature for KR AA Run Health OS. All backend APIs working perfectly, frontend UI fully functional with dropdown, day switching, impact sections, and toast notifications.
passed_tests: POST /api/demo/set-day successfully switches between day scenarios
Day 1 scenario: Low risks (5-15%), 0 actions, optimal metrics
Day 70 scenario: High risks (95%), 7 active actions, multiple deviations
Day 90 scenario: Critical phase, 7 active actions, elevated risks
Day 105 scenario: Final stretch, maximum vigilance mode
Action cards impact section with risk reduction percentages (7d, 14d, 30d)
Action cards productivity and run length impact descriptions
Urgency badges (Critical, High, Medium) correctly displayed
Day selector dropdown on Mission Control with all 7 options
Toast notifications when switching days with descriptions
UI updates correctly after day switching (KPIs, risks, actions)
Action Center impact sections showing quantified benefits
Risk levels and action counts match expected day scenarios

success_percentage.backend: 100% (30/30 API endpoints passing, including new day scenario APIs)
success_percentage.frontend: 100% (day selector dropdown, switching, impact sections, toast notifications all working)
success_percentage.integration: 100% (day switching properly updates all UI components)
